race.title: starsportsbet.co.uk Handicap Hurdle
race.verdict: CREST OF ARMS is by far the least exposed of the quintet, and he's fancied to make a winning handicap debut for an in-form yard. Course regular Ez Tiger narrowly edges out Stroll On By as the pick for the forecast, in a race where it's hard to rule out any. CREST OF ARMS EZ TIGER (IRE) STROLL ON BY (IRE)
race.bettingForecast: Ez Tiger (6/4), Crest of Arms (9/4), Basilette (3/1), Activist (5/1), Stroll On By (13/2)
